name: Qualified, sufficiently recent context
rule: At least one contextual record at/before command time with valid quality/calibration, declared unit/sensor, and age <=60 s.

name: Record identity and source time
rule: Every record has the declared event/command/zone identifiers and a finite source timestamp.

name: Unambiguous command identity
rule: One command payload after deduplication; identical retransmissions are idempotent, conflicting reuse is rejected.

name: Device acknowledgement
rule: A matched accepted acknowledgement occurs at/after command time and within 3 s.

name: Qualified flow trace
rule: At least two uniquely timed flow samples, declared L/min unit/sensor, valid calibration/quality, nonnegative values, and onset within 5 s.

name: Recorded pressure bounds
rule: Supplied pressure samples have declared unit/sensor, valid quality/calibration and 0.8-2.0 bar within the delivery window.

name: Recorded volume and window
rule: Trapezoidal integration of qualified flow gives 1.0 +/-0.1 L within the 40 s window; these are synthetic profile values.

name: Linked twin-state record
rule: A matched confirmation follows the final response record and identifies the model and profile versions.
